items.title: Nuvama initiates coverage on KPR Mill and 2 other textile stocks, sees up to 35% upside. Here's why
items.description: Nuvama Institutional Equities has initiated coverage on KPR Mill, Indo Count Industries and Sanathan Textiles with 'Buy' ratings, citing the global shift in textile sourcing away from China. The brokerage expects Indian textile exporters to benefit from supply chain realignment, supported by capacity expansion, policy tailwinds and improving trade access.

items.title: Q1 earnings this week: Infosys, Eternal, Bajaj Auto among 573 companies set to announce June quarter results
items.description: This week, 573 companies will announce their June quarter results, featuring prominent firms.  Bharti Airtel and Nykaa are among those reporting earnings on Tuesday.  Trent and Hero MotoCorp will release their quarterly figures on Thursday.  State Bank of India and Titan Company are scheduled for Friday announcements.  The earnings cycle concludes Saturday with Anant Raj's results.

items.title: Will Nifty, Sensex extend gains on Monday? 6 factors which will drive D-Street action this week
items.description: Indian stock market is expected to extend recent gains this week.  The Reserve Bank of India's policy decision will significantly influence market direction.  Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and fluctuating oil prices remain key concerns.  Foreign institutional investors are showing renewed interest in Indian equities.  Corporate earnings announcements will also provide crucial trading cues for investors.

items.title: 10 largecap stocks with upside potential up to 37%. Do you own any?
items.description: Analyst forecasts offer more than just numbers-- they provide a strategic view of future market potential. For investors seeking the next big opportunity, a closer look at BSE large-cap stocks reveals several promising contenders.Based on consensus estimates from Trendlyne, several large-cap stocks are projected to deliver strong returns over the next 12 months. This anticipated “upside” represents the average expected gain over the coming year, offering a data-driven benchmark for investors targeting high-potential opportunities. In this analysis, we highlighted 10 standout large-cap stocks expected to deliver gains in the 25% to 37% range over the year ahead.

items.title: FPIs reverse 4-month selling trend with Rs 20,200 cr inflow in July
items.description: In July, foreign investors reversed their selling trend, becoming net buyers of Indian equities for the first time in four months by investing Rs 20,200 crore. This surge is attributed to appealing valuations and stronger corporate earnings. Additionally, foreign capital flowed into the debt market, signaling a shift in interest. The future of these investments hinges on both global market conditions and domestic economic indicators.

items.title: Mcap of nine of top-10 most valued firms jumps Rs 2.51 lakh cr; Bajaj Finance biggest winner
items.description: In a surprising turn of events, nine out of the top ten firms reported a significant boost in market valuation. Leading the charge was Bajaj Finance, which added an impressive Rs 80,000 crore to its overall worth. Following closely were Bharti Airtel and TCS, both witnessing notable rises in their market capitalization. Altogether, these companies recorded a combined increase of Rs 2.

items.title: AI may hurt IT today, but it could create the sector's next growth engine: Baroda BNP Paribas MF
items.description: AI may disrupt traditional revenue streams in India’s $280-billion IT services industry, but Rohan Korde of Baroda BNP Paribas Mutual Fund believes it could also drive the sector’s next growth phase. He sees opportunities in enterprise AI deployment, data engineering, cybersecurity, cloud integration and specialised chip infrastructure, while favouring financial services, healthcare and consumer services over the next three to five years.

items.title: Dividends & stock splits: Maruti Suzuki, ICICI Bank among nearly 100 stocks turning ex-date this week. Do you own?
items.description: Nearly 100 stocks, including Maruti Suzuki, ICICI Bank, Coforge and Vedanta Aluminium, will trade ex-date between August 3 and August 7 for dividends and stock splits. Key corporate actions include Maruti Suzuki’s Rs 140-per-share dividend, Bosch’s Rs 270 payout and stock splits by Tembo Global Industries and JOJO Ltd.

items.title: 11 penny stocks surged up to 198% in 6 months. Do you own any?
items.description: Over the past six months, 11 penny stocks delivered returns ranging from 19% to 198%. The stocks were screened using the following criteria: market capitalisation below Rs 1,000 crore, share price under Rs 20, and a minimum latest trading volume of 5 lakh shares. The screen highlights actively traded low-priced micro-cap stocks that have generated strong gains.While penny stocks can offer significant upside potential, they also carry substantial risks, including low liquidity, sharp price volatility, and limited financial transparency. Investors should conduct thorough due diligence and follow prudent risk management before investing in this segment. (Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
items.description: The Indian stock market rallied around 3% over the last week, recouping its early losses despite global volatility. Analysts expect the market's direction in the coming week to hinge on the RBI MPC meeting outcome, oil prices, corporate earnings and other key domestic and global cues.
